# ADR 0004: Token-bucket rate limits per key in a shared store

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Merchant onboarding and API key platform

## Context

Limits must hold across instances.

## Decision

Bucket4j-style buckets in Redis (or PostgreSQL for a single instance) keyed by API key id.

## Consequences

Fair limits with bursts; standard headers. Redis becomes a dependency.

## Alternatives considered

Per-instance in-memory counters.
